MLA: Initialism of member of the legislative assembly.
MLADY: My Lady (used to address peers temporal, judges, etc).
MLEM: The act or sound of extending the tongue to lick something, especially one's own nose, without opening the mouth fully.
MLI: Initialism of Molecular Libraries and Imaging program.
MLORD: My Lord (used to address peers temporal, judges, etc).
MLS: Initialism of Major League Soccer, the top league of men's soccer in the US.
